name: fz519_flip_turn_sub
purpose: Flip Turn into a Substitute (issue 519): Sharpedo, p1a, breaks Tauros's Substitute with Flip Turn (step 1) and switches out at step 2. runMoveEffects sets the selfSwitch flag for the null target too (data/mods/champions/scripts.ts:349-352, sim/battle-actions.ts:1290-1296, 1311-1312). A battle of the differential fuzzing of issue 396 (free random sets, fz_179_72), cut after its step 2: adopted as a regression fixture. The choices and the seed are those of the campaign; the trace is recorded with the pinned Showdown (b2cb775).
